resources.string: Clinical photo and video documentation for healthcare professionals: bind media to the correct patient/order, encode as DICOM, and send to the hospital PACS. Not for diagnosis, triage, or long-term storage on this device.

Health data stays under the zorginstelling. Captures use app-private staging only, are wiped after a successful PACS acknowledgement, and are never written to the system gallery. Prefer worklist or EHR lookup over typing demographics by hand. Audit logs keep technical metadata, not pixel data.

EU MDR classification and a signed DPIA/GEB are still required before real-patient use — drafts live with the product team / hospital privacy officer. This build is for lab and controlled pilot preparation. A verwerkersovereenkomst and NEN 7510 evidence must be agreed with each zorginstelling.
Typically the zorginstelling is verwerkingsverantwoordelijke (controller). This app processes data on-device under their instruction; PACS/EHR remain the systems of record.
